## Progress

- Merged [PR #1437](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/1437): plan items from the services list per tooth or whole mouth in phases 1–9; Planned → In progress → Done or Declined with a reason, never deleted; estimate without declined items; acceptance with who, how and when, and "changed since accepted"; a done item is one suggested line on the visit's bill, never billed twice
- Follow-up: a waive reason for a removed suggested line, and an "unbilled done items" list for items done after the bill is issued

## Description

From the tooth chart the dentist builds a plan: procedure items on teeth and surfaces, grouped in phases, priced from the dental list. The patient sees and accepts the estimate (printed or on a tablet). Items move Planned → In progress → Done, and a done item becomes a charge on the visit invoice.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** The estimate shows each item, its tooth and its fee, and a total; acceptance records who accepted and when.
- [ ] **AC2.** A done item creates exactly one charge (idempotent), with the fee version of the day.
- [ ] **AC3.** Declined or postponed items stay on the plan with a reason.
